item.title: Overgrown hedge significantly narrowing the pavement and obstructing access., 11th August
item.description:
The overgrown hedge is located on the pavement opposite 6 Jasmine Way. The hedge has grown well beyond the boundary and is now taking up a substantial part of the footpath. At its narrowest point, there is not enough clear space for wheelchair users or mobility scooters to pass safely, and it also creates difficulty for people with pushchairs or anyone who needs more room to manoeuvre. Please could the hedge be cut back sufficiently to restore the full usable width of the pavement.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1, Jasmin Way, Hatherley, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
